headline_cluster.headline: פנסיה לכל ילד: 60 מיליון ילדים בארה"ב צורפו אוטומטית ל"חשבונות טראמפ"

clustering_note: Single-outlet (TheMarker, paywalled) story claiming 60 million US children were automatically enrolled in federal 'Trump accounts' (a child savings/investment program). US Census estimates total US population under 18 at roughly 72-73 million, so a 60-million-enrollee claim is a large share of all US children and worth checking against the program's own enrollment figures/eligibility rules (e.g., citizenship/SSN requirements, birth-year cutoffs) rather than taking the headline figure at face value.
